content_sections.body: Prepare a two-turn exchange about following up after a service call. Give the main detail, listen to one follow-up, and answer it clearly. Use this model as support: 'The repair person came this morning; when will the machine be ready?' The exchange should meet this lesson goal: Ask and answer a follow-up question about a local service.
content_sections.title: Use it in a practical exchange (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Partner A begins a realistic exchange about following up after a service call. Partner B asks for one missing detail. Swap roles and make one change to the time, place, reason, quantity, or next action. Check that the exchange achieves: Ask and answer a follow-up question about a local service.
content_sections.title: Guided dialogue (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Create a short message about following up after a service call without reading the model. Include a main event or plan and one precise detail. Speak it once slowly, then once at a natural pace. Listen for whether the key information is clear.
